entities.summary: Daniel Fallows is a British Formula One aerodynamicist who is set to serve as Technical Director of Racing Bulls from April 2026, he previously served as the technical director of the Aston Martin Formula One Team from 2022 to 2024, and was also previously Chief Engineer and Head of Aerodynamics at Red Bull Racing.
